f='toxsci-17-0686-File004.xlsx'; sh='Sheet1'
rows=tables[f][sh]['rows']
records=[]
for idx,row in enumerate(rows[2:], start=3):
    drug=row[0] if len(row)>0 else None
    truth=row[1] if len(row)>1 else None
    pred=row[6] if len(row)>6 else None
    if drug is None or str(drug).strip()=='' or truth not in ('POS','NEG') or pred not in ('Positive','Negative'):
        continue
    records.append({
        'id': str(drug),
        'score': {'ref': f'{f}/{sh}/G{idx}', 'map': {'Negative': 0, 'Positive': 1}},
        'truth': {'ref': f'{f}/{sh}/B{idx}', 'map': {'NEG': 0, 'POS': 1}}
    })
positives=[r for r in records if cells[r['truth']['ref']]=='POS']
negatives=[r for r in records if cells[r['truth']['ref']]=='NEG']
tp=sum(1 for r in positives if cells[r['score']['ref']]=='Positive')
fp=sum(1 for r in negatives if cells[r['score']['ref']]=='Positive')
print(len(records), len(positives), len(negatives), tp, fp, tp/len(positives))
